ArchiveDevice.description: A v3 device an archive holds.

name.description: The new file's name under `/share`: no path, not hidden.

secrets.description: Whether it holds the connections' secrets.

Balance.description: The days with rolled-up history, in order.

BandView.description:
A price on given weekdays for a span of the plant-local wall-clock day. In the hour a DST
change skips it never applies; in the hour it repeats it applies twice.

Block.description:
A rectangular footprint with one roof. Its width runs along x and its depth along z from its
corner, before it turns.

eave.description: The walls' height under the roof.

open.description: A carport: a post at each corner instead of walls.

rotation.description: Degrees clockwise about the corner, seen from above.

Body.description: A stylised body the browser draws.

Bounds.description: The inclusive bounds of a setting's value.

BrokerStatus.description: A broker connection's client as observed.

lastError.description: Why the last attempt or session failed; kept after a reconnect.

CarPlace.description:
A parking footprint: its width runs along x and its length along z from its corner, before
it turns.

oneOf.description: The admin's pick, when no catalogue entry matches the vehicle.

length.description: An uploaded body is scaled to it.

model.description: The uploaded GLB's id, its SHA-256 in hex.

rotation.description: Degrees clockwise about the corner, seen from above.

Cell.description: A module in one cell: rows count up the slope, columns across it, both from 0.

string.description: The string it is painted into; unassigned, it produces nothing.

Change.description: A topology change: every point, applying from an instant on.

points.description: The root first, each parent before its children.

Claim.description: A device measuring a point, by the power role it measures there.

role.description: Its power role at the point, such as `grid.power`.

Code.description: Every stable machine code the core answers with; the SPA maps each to text (ADR 11).

code.description: A stable machine code, such as `clock.unsynced`.

secrets.description: The names of the secrets set; their values are never read back.

oneOf.description: A broker's client as observed; listed only.

secrets.description: Credentials by name: a value sets one, `null` removes it, an absent name is kept.

ConnectionDraft.description: A connection as the admin enters it.

CorrectionList.description: Every MPPT input any layout version wires a string to.

CostDays.description: The days with rolled-up costs, in order, and their total.

allOf.description: A token as the API reads it: never the token.

Created.description: A token just created: the only time the token is shown.

Credentials.description: A sign-in: the admin's password alone, or a viewer's name and password.

name.description: A viewer's name; absent for the admin.

Datasheet.description: A PV module model's datasheet values.

powerCoefficient.description: Of Pmax, Voc and Isc, in %/K.

vmp.description: Volts and amperes at the maximum power point.

points.description: Each consuming point with a residual.

residual.description: In kWh, the sum of `points`: zero when the tree explains the day.

DeadbandSource.description: Where a role's deadband comes from.

Declared.description: A setting's declared values: what a write may carry.

oneOf.description: The bounds of a value; absent when `values` lists them.

step.description: A value is a whole number of steps.

values.description: The only values it takes, when the profile enumerates them.

id.description: Stable; never reused. The device id of its history.

DeviceDraft.description: Where a device sits and how it is read.

profile.description: The profile's id, such as `deye-sg05lp3`; fixed once the device is added.

unit.description:
The device address behind the connection: a Modbus unit id, or the index a broker's
profile names, such as an EVCC loadpoint's.

writes.description: Whether settings may be written (ADR 7); off when left out.

estimated.description:
Series computed from others, not measured, such as `pv.string.power[3]` of a string
in parallel (ADR 17).

settings.description: What its profile lets the core write, in the profile's order.

writes.description: Whether the admin switched its writes on (ADR 7).

Enable.description: Whether a setting may be written, as far as trust goes (ADR 8).

after.description: The value read back; `null` when nothing was written or it could not be read.

before.description:
The value read before writing; `null` when it could not be read or the setting is
write-only.

failedStep.description: The recipe step that failed, counted from 1.

refusal.description: The code an attempt was refused with before the device; `null` unless `refused`.

via.description:
The trusted device key a remote write came through (ADR 16); `null` for a write made at
home.

Equipment.description: A marker linked to its device, placed on a block's wall.

along.description: Metres from the wall's left end, seen from outside.

block.description: The block's index in the scene.

inside.description: Behind the wall, in the building.

EquipmentKind.description: What a marker stands for; a hybrid inverter may carry one of each.

Figures.description: One period's figures: a measurement's, or a counter's delta.

date.description: The plant-local date the period begins on, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

integral.description: `Σ value·duration` in the unit times hours: Wh for power.

mean.description: Time-weighted over the time with a value.

issued.description: When the value was issued, RFC 3339, UTC.

Forecasts.description: One series' forecasts, at most 1,500 points.

Found.description: An endpoint that took a connection, and the devices proposed behind it.

devices.description: Empty when no profile's identify probe was answered: the homeowner enters it by hand.

Frame.description:
Values by device id, then by series name, such as `pv.mppt.power[2]`. A value in a delta is
fresh; one in `stale` is past its gap threshold (ADR 3) and keeps its last value.

stale.description: The age in whole seconds of each stale value, by device id, then by series name.

History.description: Time-weighted means of one series over a range, at the tier the server picked.

points.description: In time order; a gap has no point.

ImportArchive.description: The v3 devices an archive holds.

ImportReport.description: What an import wrote and left out.

unmapped.description: v3 devices with readings and no v5 device: not imported.

unread.description: v3 metrics no v5 quantity reads, as `slug/key`: not imported.

devices.description: Each v3 device and the v5 device its history goes to.

path.description: The archive's path under `/share`; without it, the uploaded archive.

oneOf.description: Once done, what was written and left out.

total.description: Series the archive feeds; 0 until it is read.

IndexProblem.description: Why an index could not be read.

factors.description: The learned cells; an unlearned month and hour applies 1.

oneOf.description: The last 30 days measured against the model, absent until both exist.

Investment.description: The investment payback is measured against.

Kept.description: How long change points are kept; hourly and daily rollups are kept forever.

Label.description: The text a setting's value is shown as.

oneOf.description: Its modules name their string by position in `strings`.

LayoutChange.description: A layout change: every string, applying from an instant on.

oneOf.description:
Its modules name their string by position in `strings`; it decides their module counts
and planes.

LearnedCell.description: The multiplier for a plant-local month and hour.

lines.description: Oldest first, as written to stderr.

Location.description: The plant's location in degrees, north and east positive.

LoggedChange.description: One entry of the change log.

state.description: The subject after the change, as its own route reads it; `null` once removed.

ModuleGrid.description: The modules on one roof face.

block.description: The block's index in the scene.

face.description: The roof face's index in its block, in the order the `pv` crate lists a block's roof faces.

moduleType.description: The id of the module type, which sizes the cells.

setback.description: Metres kept free along every edge of the face.

earned.description: Earned for what was fed in.

saved.description: The bill without the plant less the bill with it.

Obstacle.description: Opaque things that cast shade. Positions are a box's corner, else the foot's centre.

oneOf.description: A trunk under a sphere crown of `radius` whose top is at `height`.

Offer.description: One entry of an index and what became of it.

Override.description: A deadband override, in the role's unit.

Password.description: The admin's password, set on the first run.

Payback.description: The savings so far against the investment, in EUR to the cent.

investment.description: What the admin entered; `null` until then.

remaining.description: What the savings have yet to pay back, none once they have; `null` without an investment.

mean.description: The value weighted by the time it held between `start` and `end`.

PointDraft.description: A point as the admin enters it.

id.description: A point kept from an earlier version; absent for a new point.

parent.description: The index in `points` of an earlier point; `null` for the root, which comes first.

PointResidual.description: The energy a consuming point gave out that its measured children do not explain.

PointView.description: One point of a topology version.

claims.description: In order: the first with a reading is read.

contested.description: Claimed by more than one device: flagged, never summed (ADR 14).

parent.description: The parent point's id; `null` for the root.

code.description: A stable machine code, such as `auth.required`.

Proposal.description: A device the identify probe of a profile found.

variant.description:
The variant the probe found: for SunSpec, the device model after the common model, such
as 103 for a three-phase inverter.

Publish.description:
The publisher of a broker connection: the `plant` device's role values and each device's
availability.

discovery.description: Whether Home Assistant discovery is sent.

PvString.description: Modules in series on one plane; strings on one MPPT input are in parallel.

Reach.description: How the core reaches an endpoint, without its secrets.

oneOf.description:
What a broker publishes under its topic root (ADR 10); none when left out, and refused for
any other transport.

topicRoot.description:
A broker's topic root, such as `evcc`, under which its profiles' topics sit; required for a
broker and refused for any other transport.

RecentEnergy.description:
In kWh, over the whole hours of the last 30 days the input is modelled on archive weather and
measured, short of the inverter's AC limit; the model uncorrected.

Report.description: An index and the outcome of its last check.

checked.description: Whether it was checked since the core started.

Reprice.description: A tariff applying from a date, even a past one.

RoleDeadband.description: The deadband a role of a device is stored with.

deadband.description: In the role's unit; `null` stores every change.

oneOf.description: Rises from the front eave (+z) to the back.
Its ridge runs along the width.
Its ridge runs along the longer side.

endpoints.description: Every endpoint that took a connection, by address.

subnet.description:
A private IPv4 network of at most a /24, such as `192.168.1.0/24`; by default the /24 of
the core's own address.

Scene.description: The geometry of a plant and where its modules sit.

grids.description: At most one per roof face.

north.description: The compass bearing, in degrees clockwise from true north, of the scene's forward axis, −z.

bands.description: Bands of one flow never share a minute of a weekday.

price.description: EUR/kWh, signed; charged wherever no band applies.

Schemas.description: An inclusive range of profile schemas.

enable.description: Whether trust lets it write (ADR 8); the device's `writes` switch applies as well.

labels.description: The text for each value the profile labels.

name.description: What the settings screen calls it; the key when absent.

unit.description: The unit of its value, such as `A`.

SettingSupport.description: A setting a device's profile declares (ADR 5, 7).

value.description: In the setting's unit, a whole number of its steps.

SpotPriceZone.description: Whether spot prices are fetched, and for which bidding zone.

points.description: In time order; a period without rolled-up history has none.

Status.description: What became of one entry of an index.

id.description: A string kept from an earlier version; absent for a new string.

Support.description:
What this core supports (ADR 9). The schemas and capabilities are the profile crate's table,
the one its WASM build reports.

capabilities.description: The bindings, decoders and computed quantities a profile may require.

devices.description: By device id, what the layout in force says of its series.

schema.description: The profile schemas this core loads.

Tariff.description: One tariff version, as the API reads it.

export.description: What a kWh fed into the grid earns.

import.description: What a kWh bought from the grid costs.

TariffChange.description: A tariff change, applying from an instant on.

appliesFrom.description: RFC 3339, not before now; now when absent.

Tier.description:
`raw` intervals between change points, UTC-aligned buckets of them, or `hour` (UTC) or
`day` (plant-local) rollups.

Token.description: A token as the API reads it: never the token.

TokenDraft.description: A token as the admin creates it.

name.description: What it is for, such as `evcc`.

Topology.description: One topology version, as the API reads it.

points.description: Each parent before its children, the root first.

Transport.description: The wire framing on a connection's endpoint.

Update.description: A served profile and the update waiting for it, as the admin reviews it.

quantities.description: The quantities it changes, in the same order.

settings.description: The settings it changes, in the served profile's order, then those it adds.

Viewer.description: A viewer as the API reads it: never its password.

ViewerDraft.description: A viewer as the admin adds it.

name.description: What the viewer signs in with; unique.

Wall.description: A side of a block's footprint: the front along +z, the right along +x.

Warning.description:
A string whose open-circuit voltage in the cold exceeds its inverter's maximum DC input
voltage: saved all the same, since the plant may already exist (ADR 20).

Wiring.description:
Where a string sits and what it is made of. With a scene, its module counts and plane are
derived: the plane is that of its first module.

input.description: The MPPT input, from 1, as the `pv.mppt.*` index.

optimized.description: How many of its modules have an optimizer.

post.summary:
Backs up the store and the car bodies into a new file under `/share`, readable by the core's
user alone; the secrets only when asked.

get.summary:
The residual per plant-local day (ADR 14): energy a consuming point gave out that its
measured children do not explain, so a missing or misplaced point.

Stores a GLB of at most 20 MB with every buffer and image embedded; the same file twice is
one body.

get.summary: An uploaded body.
Every configuration change, oldest first.

post.summary: Adds a connection: an endpoint and its credentials.

delete.summary: Removes a connection no device uses.

put.summary: Changes a connection; its devices are polled through it at once.

parameters.description: The first instant, RFC 3339: a day starting from it on is read.
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: The instant after the last, RFC 3339.
parameters.name: to

get.summary:
What the plant paid, earned and saved per plant-local day, from the daily rollups of the
`cost.*` rates; the current day covers its closed hours.

post.summary: Adds a device behind a connection and starts polling it.

delete.summary: Removes a device and stops polling it; its history stays under its id.

put.summary: Changes a device's name, connection or unit id; its profile is fixed.

get.summary:
Each role of a device with the deadband it is stored with (ADR 4): the admin's override, else
the profile's, else the role's default, else none.

delete.summary: Removes a role's deadband override; the profile's or the role's default applies at once.

put.summary:
Overrides a role's deadband for this device. Its series are stored with it at once, after
their pending change points are written. Refused below the role's quantisation step and on a
counter or enum.

parameters.description: The instant after the last target, RFC 3339.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Only issues before this instant, RFC 3339; the latest issue when absent.
parameters.name: issuedBefore

parameters.description: The instant after the last, RFC 3339.
parameters.name: to

put.summary:
Writes a setting through the one funnel (ADR 7) and answers the attempt as the write log keeps
it. A refusal never reaches the device.

delete.summary: Withdraws the admin's enable of a setting.

put.summary:
Enables the writes of a setting as its profile declares it now (ADR 8). A community profile's
setting, or an official one not verified on hardware, writes only while enabled; a changed
declaration is off again until re-enabled.

parameters.description: The first instant, RFC 3339: each period starting from it on is read.
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: The instant after the last, RFC 3339.
parameters.name: to

get.summary:
One series' figures for each plant-local period starting in the range, folded from its
daily rollups.
Where the import stands: idle, running with its progress, or its result.

post.summary: Starts importing an archive; one import runs at a time, while the core keeps polling.

get.summary: The v3 archives under `/share`, by path. Symlinks are not followed.

post.summary: Stores an uploaded v3 archive for the next import, replacing the last; answers its devices.

put.summary: Sets the investment payback is measured against.

get.summary: The layout in force at an instant.

put.summary: Changes the layout from an instant on; new strings get fresh ids.

get.summary:
Server-sent events: a `snapshot` of every value on connect, then a `delta` per second in
which a value changed or went stale. There is no replay: a client that falls behind is disconnected and
reconnects to a fresh snapshot.
The plant's location.

put.summary: Sets the plant's location, stored to 0.01°; the weather and solar forecasts follow at once.

204.description: Signed in; the cookie is set

post.summary: Signs the admin, or a viewer by name, in to a session cookie.

get.summary: The core's last 2,000 log lines, each at most 1 KiB (ADR 2).

post.summary: Adds a module type; the admin enters its datasheet, there is no catalogue.

get.summary: The savings so far against the investment.
The official profile index, then each one the admin added, with the outcome of its last check.

post.summary:
Adds a profile index and fetches it at once; its profiles load as community profiles unless
signed by the profile key.
Checks every index for updates: the only fetch besides adding an index, never on a timer.

get.summary:
The updates a check found for profiles served, each with what it changes; none is served
until the admin applies it.

post.summary:
Applies the update waiting for a profile. Each setting it adds or changes is off until the
admin enables it again (ADR 8).

get.summary: How many days change points are kept.

put.summary: Sets how many days change points are kept; older ones expire within minutes.

parameters.description: One device's id; the `plant` device when absent.
parameters.name: device

get.summary:
The live value of a series such as `grid.power` or `grid.phase.current[2]`, from the `plant`
device or one device, in EVCC's sign convention: a battery is positive when discharging. A
series without a live value, such as one the device does not report, is `role.none`.

post.summary:
Scans the local network for devices and proposes a profile and unit id for each (ADR 6). Read
only; an endpoint already configured is not touched.

get.summary: Whether the request carries a live session.

post.summary: The first run sets the admin password; there is no registration.

get.summary: The bidding zone spot prices are fetched for.

put.summary: Chooses the bidding zone spot prices are fetched for, or none; the device follows at once.

get.summary: The tariff in force at an instant.

put.summary:
Changes the tariff from an instant on. Editing changes only the future: prices already in force
stay as they were.

post.summary:
Corrects the past: the tariff applies from its date, and the prices and the `cost.*` rates are
rebuilt from then on from stored history. Refused before change-point retention.

get.summary: The plant timezone days are cut in.

put.summary: Sets the plant timezone; days from now on are cut in it.

post.summary: Creates a token and shows it, once.

delete.summary: Removes a token; a request carrying it is refused from now on.

get.summary: The topology in force at an instant.

put.summary:
Changes the topology from an instant on; new points get fresh ids. Aggregates already stored
keep the topology they were computed with (ADR 14).

post.summary: Adds a viewer, who reads live values and history.

delete.summary: Removes a viewer and ends its sessions.

get.summary: Every write attempt, oldest first.
